design: Opt-in Connection::drive_with takes background I/O ownership lazily on first poll, uses epochs to retire stale drivers, polls protocol with existing connection mutex/event/timer/transmit machinery, and restores background I/O on completion/cancellation. Initial version polls IO before and after application. Readiness version skips idle IO only if valid matching reader registration exists, no buffered transmit is blocked and no timer is elapsed; clears idle marker to preserve quantum continuations. Deferred version moves post-write transmit to next scheduled poll. All are insufficient substitutes for worker-owned explicit readiness and batching.
